pkgmetadata.longdescription: A Windows-style installer for Linux: double-click a .deb, .rpm, .snap, AppImage, Flatpak, Windows .exe/.msi, .jar or an archive and it is installed per user, without root, with a menu entry, an icon and a clean uninstall. Snaps run without snapd, packages that hard-code /usr paths run with an overlay, Windows programs run through Wine (system, PortProton or Steam Proton). Downloads are checksum-verified and installed apps can be updated in the background. A GTK4/libadwaita window and a CLI.

use.flag: Install flatpak: references, bundles and Flathub ids through the flatpak tool
Run Windows .exe/.msi programs (needs Wine; PortProton and Steam Proton are found too)
